option.name: --force

option.name: --force-conflicts

option.name: --grace-period
tip: Period of time in seconds given to the resource to terminate gracefully.
Ignored if negative.

Can only be set to 0 when --force is true (force deletion).

tip: If true, use openapi to calculate diff when the openapi presents and the resource can be found in the openapi spec.

option.name: --prune

option.name: --server-side
tip: If true, apply runs in the server instead of the client.

tip: If specified, apply will operate on the subresource of the requested object.

tip: The length of time to wait before giving up on a delete, zero means determine a timeout from the size of the object

tip: The condition to wait on: [create|delete|condition=condition-name[=condition-value]|jsonpath='{JSONPath expression}'=[JSONPath value]].
The default condition-value is true.
Condition values are compared after Unicode simple case folding, which is a more general form of case-insensitivity.
Multiple conditions are supported and AND'ed to each other in a sequential order.
If --for=create is passed, it is always waited first.

option.name: --local
tip: If true, annotation will NOT contact api-server but run locally.

option.name: --timeout
tip: The length of time to wait before giving up.
Zero means check once and don't wait, negative means wait for a week.
